<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Request Refund">6f44d681832407d07bfa9470ceaad3b9</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:61562ac583a407d07bfa9470ceaad3f0</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Date</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    // Get the date entered by the user
    var purchaseDate = new Date(newValue);

    // Get today's date and reset time to midnight for a fair comparison
    var today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Check if the purchase date is in the future
    if (purchaseDate > today) {
        // Display an error message directly on the field
        g_form.addErrorMessage("The purchase date cannot be a future date. Please enter a valid date.");

        // Clear the field value to force the user to correct it
        g_form.setValue("purchase_date", "");

    } else {
        // Valid date: clear any previous error message
		g_form.clearMessages();
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-29 00:57:21</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>f1b63b1583ec87d07bfa9470ceaad334</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Date</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="NowRefund" source="x_1960572_now_rfd">6ae464c983a4c3d07bfa9470ceaad339</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="NowRefund">6ae464c983a4c3d07bfa9470ceaad339</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_f1b63b1583ec87d07bfa9470ceaad334</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-08 20:16:58</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
